Overflow Layouts

These layouts demonstrate the overflow attribute with column layouts.
The overflow="preview" shows a partial preview of the next item. Each carousel below pairs stagger (per-card reveal as you swipe) with a wilder animate-self="…() trigger-both" container entry (3D flips + clip-path reveals) — trigger-both replays it every time you scroll away and back. The Pages demo at the end is stagger-only. (Big-translate effects like bounce-in-up can't drive an animate-self container entry — the element translates out of its own scroll-trigger's view range and deadlocks — so the wild set here is transform-in-place: rotate / clip.)

↓ Scroll down to see the carousels animate in ↓

Carousel controls — nav

Shared carousel controls from ui/base/carousel.css: dots + arrows via the nav attribute <lay-out overflow nav stagger animate-self="flip-up() trigger-both">

Band below — nav="blw"

Controls in a reserved band below the items — bare arrows <lay-out overflow nav="blw" arrow="bare" stagger animate-self="flip-left() trigger-both">

Band above — nav="abv" + arrow="set"

Controls in a band above the items, arrow pair clustered at the inline-end <lay-out overflow nav="abv" arrow="set" stagger animate-self="flip-diagonal() trigger-both">

Clustered arrows on media — arrow="set be"

Arrow pair as one cluster in the bottom-end corner, dots bottom-center <lay-out overflow nav arrow="set be" stagger animate-self="reveal(polygon) trigger-both">

Dots below, arrows on media — dot="blw"

Dots alone in a band below; arrows stay centered on the items <lay-out overflow nav dot="blw" stagger animate-self="flip-right() trigger-both">

Arrows below, dots on media — arrow="blw"

Arrows alone in a band below; dots stay on the items <lay-out overflow nav arrow="blw" stagger animate-self="flip-down() trigger-both">

Dots only, pill timer — nav="dot" + dot="pll"

No arrows; the current pill fills over --ui-carousel-autoplay (5s) <lay-out overflow nav="dot" dot="pll" stagger animate-self="reveal(circle) trigger-both">

Arrows only, dark — nav="arw" + arrow="drk"

No dots; dark circles with white chevrons, auto-hidden at the dead end (arrow="hid") <lay-out overflow nav="arw" arrow="drk hid" stagger animate-self="reveal(inset) trigger-both">

Preview + controls — overflow="preview" + nav

Next-item preview composes with controls — arrows advance one item at a time; dots in a band below via dot="blw", full-arrow glyph via arrow="arr". (For a control-less swipe scroller, overflow="stop" gives the same one-item-per-fling stepping.) <lay-out md="columns(2)" overflow="preview" nav dot="blw" arrow="arr">

Pages + stagger — pages + stagger

Snap + dot per page of N items (dot count adapts per breakpoint), dots in a band below via dot="blw". stagger reveals the carousel as it scrolls into view and each card as you swipe — scroll-driven, so it re-runs on scroll back (add trigger for a one-shot). stagger="rise|fall|lft|rgt|zom|blr|fde" picks the effect (bare = rise). <lay-out md="columns(2)" lg="columns(3)" overflow nav pages stagger dot="blw">

Preview Sizes

Control the preview width with size modifiers. All examples use columns(1).

Extra Small

40px preview width <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview-xs">

Small

60px preview width <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview-sm">

Medium (default)

100px preview width <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview">

Large

150px preview width <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview-lg">

Extra Large

200px preview width <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview-xl">

2XL

25% of the carousel width (container-relative) <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview-2xl">

Centered — peek both sides (center)

overflow="… center" centers the current slide and reveals a sliver of the previous and next items. Pair with a preview* token for the peek size; preview-2xl (25% of the carousel width) yields ≈50% current / ≈25% each side. Compose with bleed for a full-screen cinematic carousel.

Centered preview — overflow="preview-2xl center"

current ≈50% · previous ≈25% · next ≈25% <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview-2xl center" nav="blw" arrow="bare">

Full-screen — bleed + overflow="preview-2xl center"

edge-to-edge; controls compose unchanged <lay-out bleed md="columns(1)" overflow="preview-2xl center" nav="blw" arrow="bare">

Fade Masks

Add fade effects to the overflow edges. Masks animate based on scroll position. All examples use columns(1).

Fade Both

Fade masks on both start and end edges <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview fade">

Fade Start

Fade mask on start edge only <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview fade-start">

Fade End

Fade mask on end edge only <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview fade-end">
